instruction: Register the helloExtension from /home/user/Desktop/ in Chrome's extension manager as an unpacked extension.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: Variation 8: Uses 'register' terminology and 'extension manager'. Evaluator checks for /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension in extensions list. Task requires navigating to chrome://extensions/, enabling Developer mode, clicking Load unpacked, and selecting the extension folder.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: extracts all unpacked extension paths from Chrome Preferences file (extensions.settings.<id>.path)
Metric logic is correct: is_in_list properly checks if expected path is present in the list of extension paths
Expected value is semantically correct: '/home/user/Desktop/helloExtension' matches the exact location prepared by config
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the core requirement that the extension is registered in Chrome
Data flow is correct: getter returns List[str], metric checks string membership in list, expected provides string
Practical feasibility: Chrome Preferences file is persistent and updated when extension is loaded, no stale state issues
Postconfig opens chrome://extensions/ but this is not needed since getter reads from persistent Preferences file
